from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document parsed from the collection."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
